text:
oncall-bot: Pager: suspicious session cookie dump detected in edge-proxy logs (ingest 03:12 UTC). Large raw cookies present in access logs, forwarding to S3. Possible PII/token exposure. Link: https://internal/logs/edge/2101234567 — please ack.

devon: ack — pulling context and isolating hosts. I see raw Cookie headers in /var/log/nginx/access.log on edge-03 and edge-07. Sample below.

devon: ```
edge-03 03:11:58 GET /api/chat 200 - "Cookie: session=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
edge-07 03:12:02 GET /embed 200 - "Cookie: session=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
```

tara (security): I'm on. Initial containment: (A) block the offending IPs at the WAF, (B) stop log forwarding to S3, (C) rotate the session signing key, (D) revoke recent sessions, (E) scrub leaked objects. Who can flip the logshipper?

kevin (infra): on it — I'll pause the logshipper and add a suppression filter to stop logging Cookie headers. Command:```bash
kubectl scale deployment/logshipper -n infra --replicas=0
# then patch filter to drop header 'Cookie' in fluentd config
```

morgan (auth): I can rotate the cookie signing key in KMS but note: rotation invalidates existing cookies. Recommend: rotate key + run targeted revoke for sessions created in last 24h. ETA ~12m to push new key and roll auth pods.

devon: can we do a scoped revoke? We have admin endpoint: POST /admin/revoke-sessions {"cutoff_ts": <unix>} — will only revoke sessions issued before cutoff. Prefer cutoff for last 24h.

morgan (auth): ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://internal-api/admin/revoke-sessions -d '{"cutoff_ts":2101230000}'
# returns job id: rsv-3287
```

tara (security): plan agreed. Sequence: 1) pause logshipper & stop S3 forwarding 2) block IPs 3) rotate key 4) run revoke job 5) scrub leaked S3 objects and set aggressive retention 6) run detection for honeytokens. I'll open INC-2101 and draft customer-notify with legal.

legal-notify-bot: Legal note: prepare a provisional template for 'data exposure' but hold public notice until we confirm exfiltration. We'll prepare two drafts (non-actionable/noticeable). I'll join the bridge in 30m.

kevin (infra): WAF rules applied — blocked 3 IPs (54.23.11.7, 198.51.100.22, 203.0.113.5). Logshipper replicas scaled to 0; suppression rule added to fluentd to drop Cookie header. Stopped forwarding to S3: job s3-fwd-stop-2101 complete. :white_check_mark: 

devon: revoke job rsv-3287 started (cutoff 2101230000). Progress: 18% completed across auth shards. Pushing sample evidence to internal bucket gs://evidence/incidents/INC-2101/samples.log (retention 7d).

morgan (auth): Key rotation done in KMS: new key version auth-cookie-v3 created. Rolling update started for auth-service with AUTH_COOKIE_KEY=auth-cookie-v3, restarting 3 pods.

devon: auth pods restarted and are serving v3. Revoke job finished — sessions created before cutoff invalidated. Monitoring for customer errors; no spike in 5xx or auth failures so far.

tara (security): follow-ups: kevin to scrub S3 bucket 'edge-logs-internal' (ticket INF-4321), morgan to run post-rotate validation and replay checks (ensure v3 signs correctly), devon to run a regex hunt across other buckets for cookie patterns and honeytoken hits, legal to finalize notification decision if exfiltration confirmed. Next update in 30m. :rotating_light: :lock: :pager:

devon: final notes: saved a copy of leaked lines to evidence bucket, set retention 7d and access audit. Incident ticket INC-2101 created and assigned to sec-eng for postmortem. Closing this slack thread after the next update.
